description: This PHP class defines a REST API endpoint for managing Employee Education records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee education data, following REST principles with embedded Swagger annotations for API documentation. The class interacts with service and DAO layers to perform database operations and includes validation rules for request parameters and body payloads.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationAPI
classes.description: Defines RESTful API endpoints for managing employee education records in the HR system, supporting CRUD operations with validation, documentation annotations, and interaction with service/DAO layers to persist/retrieve data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee education record by ID and employee number, throws an exception if not found, returns a resource result with the data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all education records for a specified employee, supports sorting and pagination, returns a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new education record for an employee, delegating persistence to service/DAO layers, returns the created resource.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee education record identified by ID, throws if not found, persists changes, and returns the updated resource.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee education records based on provided IDs, returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Populates an EmployeeEducation entity with data from request parameters and saves it via DAO layer.
